themes.summary: Aramco and KPC say inventory buffers are finite or evaporating, while Middle East exports ran 14.5 million b/d in September, about 66% of Jan-Feb.
Hormuz transits rose to 25 ships on Oct. 4 with nine VLCCs, and Brent and WTI settled lower on Oct. 5.

themes.theme: Saudi OSP cut and OPEC+ quotas
themes.summary: Aramco cut November Asia OSPs $3-$5/b and OPEC+ kept November quotas unchanged.
G7 will release 100 million barrels over four months with diesel prioritized, after the IEA's 400 million-barrel March draw.
Singapore gasoil crack hit $83.02/b on Sept. 16, US distillate stocks are seen at 103.7 million bbl, and Russia extended its diesel export ban.
Russia's September seaborne crude exports rose to 4.088 million b/d despite new US and Japanese sanctions, with India-bound volumes down 59% m/m.
Australia's outlook sees Brent at $135/b in disruption or $101.11/b baseline in Q4, and ConocoPhillips plans on $70/b Brent.
US output could reach 14.5 million b/d per ConocoPhillips, Guyana capacity is heading above 1 million b/d, and Venezuela output is 1.218 million b/d.
